source_title: Payouts Guide For Creators Outside Of The Us
source_date_if_available: Accessed April 2026; page undated in search index

snippets.snippet_text: [Stated in layout: "Fees: A small flat fee (e.g., about $0.50 local equivalent per payout, varies by currency). Minimum payout of $10 or local equivalent."]

[Stated in layout: "Fees: 1.55% of payout amount + $0.25 per payout. No additional currency conversion fee is applied. Minimum payout of $10. Conversion: Patreon handles the conversion from USD → local currency before sending to your bank."]
[Stated in layout: "Fees: $0.50 per payout. Conversion: No additional currency conversion happens at payout time, since the transfer is from USD to a USD bank account."]
